subtitle: Lesson 5 · Users and Access

caption: Every profile in the org, standard and custom. Standard profiles can't be edited directly — only cloned.
Standard profiles are locked. To customize, clone an existing profile, name the copy, and edit that instead.
Profiles sits in the same Administration group as Permission Sets and Permission Set Groups — the next two lessons.

subtitle: Adding access on top of a profile, without cloning anything.
